profile.headline: Technologist, Tech Trainer & Speaker • Adobe, Canvas & Zoom – Community Expert/UGM • Adobe Certified Professional in Marketing Design

website.text: Need help with Tech? Find Me!

profile.summary:
I'm a Digital Technologist, Web Developer, Social Media Specialist, and Trainer... I manage and curate over 40 different brand programs and their associated communities for continuing education, overseeing social media communications, creating visual and video content, as well as hosting, moderating, promoting and technical-producing webinar and live stream events. I also manage all digital credential assets for those programs.  

I taught web design and development at California State University Dominguez Hills, originating and instructional designing the accredited, CEU-based Web Design Certificate Program since 1995. I am an Adobe Technical Consultant and Community Expert (ACE), an active teaching assistant for Adobe MAX (Adobe’s annual international creative conference), and a co-manager/host of an official Adobe user group, Los Angeles Web Professionals Group (LAWPG). I'm also a Zoom Community Professional. I have been a past guest speaker for various Women in STEM, Women in Business, and Tech Inclusion/Diversity events. Wherever I speak, I try to interject my personality and an atmosphere of creative fun in technology.

As a front-end web developer and graphic designer, I am an Adobe Certified Dreamweaver Expert and Developer, and am a Master Level subject matter expert in HTML and Dreamweaver, contributing to several training materials on web development, and co-authoring the current official Adobe Dreamweaver ACA Certification exam. I have received awards for my work on high-end e-commerce, consumer, entertainment, community service and education sites.

A former Google Apps for Education administrator, I am proficient at explaining complicated technical concepts to users of varying degrees of understanding. Skilled in providing training, IT support and professional development for various operating systems, software applications, hardware and office/classroom technology integration in both primary and secondary education as well as professional environments.

(I am also a published stock image photographer, a 1.5 ton locomotive engineer, and I’ve piloted the Goodyear Blimp.)

Specialties: website design, development, and web accessibility; content management systems, custom built websites; HTML, CSS, PHP, MySQL, WordPress; Adobe Certified Expert (Design, Video, and Web); digital photography, videography, video production; digital marketing and social media marketing.

[Clifton Strengths: #Adaptability, #Connectedness, #Learner, #Maximizer, #Intellection]

positions.title: Sr Web Developer, Social Media Specialist; Digital Technologist
positions.locationName: College of Continuing & Professional Education, 1000 E. Victoria St., Carson, CA · Hybrid
positions.description:
SENIOR WEB DEVELOPER/DIGITAL CREDENTIAL TECH ADMIN: 
• Utilize Percussion Rhythmyx CMS to create/update CCPE university front-end website content, including SEO and WCAG/accessibility. 
• Provide website integration for Blackboard & Canvas LMS, PeopleSoft, Badgr/Canvas Credentials, LiveChat, and other 3rd-party vendor support platforms. 
• Administrate, build, and manage digital credentials issuers and distribution for all campus organizations, and student populations using Badgr/Canvas Credentials.
• Create and manage Zoom webinar live-streamed events, technical integration, and promotion as one of seven campus administrators. 
• Administrate, integrate, and track metrics and stats using Google Analytics/Tag Manager, and other tools. 
• Manage Sharepoint & Office365 communication tools for various project teams throughout CCPE.

VIDEO CONTENT PRODUCER: 
• Create, manage, and supervise all video/graphic assets for marketing projects. Create social media and website graphics, and branding/logos. 
• Produce and curate video content YouTube channels and LinkedIn Livestreams, and build involvement using live video broadcast tools. 
• Revise and update email marketing campaigns using Constant Contact, SalesForce. 
• Supervise marketing student assistant team with various promotional media content projects.

SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER: 
• Create and maintain online social presence and branding for 35+ CCPE, Open University, Online, International, Certificate, and Degree programs, including YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Instagram, Google Business/Maps, Yelp, and Bing Business. 
• Coordinate with and instruct faculty, staff, and student assistants on social media interaction, content strategy/execution, instructional design, and accessibility. 
• Customize and integrate Eventbrite, LiveChat, FB Messenger, Google Business, and other customer support web components into Facebook pages and website content, increasing both positive student feedback and enrollment.

projects.title: Ambassador Andrew Young: An Icon of a Movement
projects.description:
Thanks to/alongside Nicole Pacada and the Osher Lifelong Learning Institute - OLLI at CSUDH, I had the honor of technically producing and livestreaming a uniquely historic event: a live discussion with the incredible Ambassasor Andrew [sharp 88-years-] Young! 

It was a pleasure to virtually "stage-direct" the event which also featured Ambassador Steve Rhodes, Dr. Donna Nicol, and Deborah Roberson of California State University, Dominguez Hills. In addition, I created the visual assets and promoted the event.
